reviews.text: The new update is horrible. What happened!? I’m so disappointed! This has reliably been an excellent photo and video editing app until 3 days ago! Now the not only looks annoyingly less intuitive, but more importantly it takes forever to even launch & load up. There is no longer a way to select a face to edit- especially for Video, there is not even a visible Save button (you have to quit the app, relaunch and go back to previous edit to save your project!) , there isn’t an arrow back to your main gallery, many of the buttons are hard to press- it’s as if they’re frozen! I used to use this app to quickly, seamlessly and sophisticatedly edit all my photos and videos for social media- solo and group photos! Now the app is shockingly slow and glitchy, and you can even select a face to edit! Let alone save or toggle back to the gallery! And whatever features have been retained take forever to work or load. This is absolutely tragic.
